prompt: riders should be able to reserve bikes in VeloCity before unlocking them, and technicians too when they go pick up a broken one. Can you capture the intents for reservations? (Intents in this repo live in docs/intents/<name-of-intent>.md.)
assertions: Every intent names one business-role actor (not system/user)
Every intent states the business value ('so that')
No solution vocabulary outside a spec/technical-notes section
No Given/When/Then acceptance criteria in intents (left to the spec)
Each intent title is a single goal (no 'and'/'manage'/'handle'/'support')
Each intent has a unique sequence number (project history order)
Each intent is placed on a story map (activity recorded)
No spec.md, plan.md or code produced
Intent set passes intents.py check (0 errors)
At least 3 separate intent files (epic split)
Technician reservation is its own intent, separate from the rider's
Reservation duration is not invented (no concrete minutes/seconds outside open questions)
